subject: Private deployment commercial — BrightPath VPC pricing & support tiers
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment proposal for BrightPath — initial commercial summary

Hi Alicia — great to meet last week. Attached is the high-level commercial (BrightPath_Proposal_v1.pdf) for a VPC/private deployment. Quick summary below so procurement has a single page to review: 

- Platform fee (annual amortized): $180K/year base for a 12-month commitment (covers control plane, observability retention x30d, model catalog syncs).
- Operator licenses: $7,500 per operator seat (first 5 seats included in pilot).
- Node credits: 1,000 node-hours/month included; overage at $1.50/node-hour or option to prepurchase burst credits.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 12hr initial response) vs Premium (24/7 + SRE-on-call add-on).
- Migration credit: discretionary, TBD based on pilot success.

Next steps: 1) Clarify amortization vs prepay preference, 2) confirm operator-seat counting method, 3) procurement items (po template, desired contract term).

If you can loop in Tom from procurement, we can get the PO template and a target date to close. Happy to hop on a short call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightpathhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal for BrightPath — initial commercial summary

Ben — thanks for the proposal and summary. A few procurement clarifying questions from our side before we escalate to legal: 

1) Platform fee amortization — are you able to offer amortization over 18 months vs the 12-month shown? Our finance prefers smoothing for budget phasing.
2) Operator license accounting — do you count active seats per calendar month or concurrent seats? For our SRE model we'll likely need burst operators for cutover.
3) Migration credit — can you provide a scoping rubric so procurement can justify the credit? Our IT lead will want a clear milestone link.
4) Support tiers — what's the cost delta to upgrade from Standard to Premium (monthly)?

Tom: attaching our standard PO terms (PO-terms.pdf) so Redwood can flag any clauses that won't work for you. We have an internal procurement review next Thurs (30 Jun), so if we can align terms this week that would be ideal.

Appreciate it,
Alicia
Director, Digital Platforms
BrightPath Health

Hi Alicia / Tom — thanks for the clear list. I've pulled together options below (attached detailed workbook: pricing-workbook.xlsx) so procurement can see trade-offs. High-level answers: 

1) Amortization options: we can offer either 12-month prepay, 12-month amortized invoicing, or 18-month amortization on the platform fee. 18-month amortization carries a modest uplift (effective +6% total over 18 months) to account for licensing exposure; that said, we can absorb some of that if BrightPath commits to an 18-month minimum term.

2) Operator counting: we count concurrent active operator seats for billing. For cutovers we recommend temporarily elevating to Premium support + additional operator licenses; we can provide a one-time "cutover burst" of 200 operator-hours (not seats) to smooth transition if agreed up front.

3) Migration credit rubric: we tie credits to milestone completion (pilot roll -> 50% traffic -> full production). Typical one-time credit ranges $15–30k depending on scope. Workbook shows an example $25k credit if full production within 90 days.

4) Support delta: Standard -> Premium runs approximately +$40K/year for the configuration in the proposal (for an org of BrightPath scale). Exact number depends on SLOs and on-call rotation frequency.

Suggested concession (if procurement pushes): we can offer a 15% first-year platform fee discount for a 12-month commitment, or 20% if BrightPath signs an 18-month commit and prepays year one. Migration credit cap at $25k for the standard offer, higher by approval.

I'll leave Ben/Laura to comment on contract/PO friction points — happy to schedule a 30-min alignment with Tom today.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-workbook.xlsx

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal for BrightPath — initial commercial summary

Thanks Stephanie — that helps. From procurement side a few constraints we need addressed before we can recommend to legal: 

- BrightPath needs a firm cap on exit/rollback costs (we require a 90-day transition assistance cap with an explicit maximum liability for migration assistance).
- Platform fee: our finance is asking for a 25% discount off the listed platform fee in year one for budget reasons.
- Migration credit: we'd prefer $50k to cover external systems integration (EHR connector costs). If you can't meet $50k, can you offer a 30k credit + a milestone-based credit uplift if the pilot completes early?
- Payment terms: PO-based net45, and we prefer SOW-linked milestone invoicing rather than a single annual invoice.

I've attached our PO template and highlighted a few clauses that often require redlines. If Redwood can accommodate the exit cap and a more compelling migration credit we'll push this through legal quickly. Our internal deadline to bind budget is 30 Jun.

Regards,
Tom Reynolds
Procurement Manager, BrightPath Health

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment proposal for BrightPath — procurement asks (Tom)

Forwarding Tom's procurement email — key asks summarized below and my suggested playbook before we respond to procurement: 

Tom asks: 25% platform discount, $50k migration credit, 90-day exit cap + milestone invoicing (net45).

Options to offer (ranked):
A) Commercially aggressive: 18-month commit, year-one prepay, 20% platform discount + $30k migration credit + 1-month complimentary Premium on-call for first cutover. Cap exit assistance to $40k.
B) Balanced: 12-month commit amortized over 18 months, 15% platform discount + $25k migration credit, milestone invoicing allowed (SOW-based), exit cap at $50k with limited hourly rate.
C) Conservative: standard pricing but include migration credit only on early completion.

Recommended: Option A if legal can accept shorter indemnity language. It hits their ask on discount, reduces migration gap, and gives them operational support in the cutover. If we can't do A, go balanced (B).

Laura — can your contracts team review the exit cap language? Happy to join a quick call to negotiate terms with Tom tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightpathhealth.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightpathhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment proposal for BrightPath — final counteroffer

Tom / Alicia — thanks for the transparency and the PO template. We ran the scenarios with Contracts and Finance and can make the following one-time counteroffer to close this week: 

- Commitment: 18-month term.
- Platform fee: 20% discount on year-one platform fee (applied to the line-item in BrightPath_Proposal_v1.pdf). Year two pricing will revert to standard list unless a renewal is agreed.
- Payment / amortization: Year-one fee may be amortized over 18 months; Redwood requires a signed PO and an executed SOW within the term to lock discounts. Net45 acceptable per PO.
- Migration credit: $30,000 applied as a one-time credit against the first invoice; additional milestone uplift of up to $10k if pilot completes prior to 60 days.
- Exit assistance cap: Redwood will commit up to $40,000 of transition assistance for the 90-day wind-down; above that work is billable at our standard services rates (will add language to SOW).
- Support: complimentary Premium on-call for first 30 days post-cutover (to cover operational stabilization).

Attached is a redlined SOW reflecting these commercial terms (SOW_BrightPath_REDLINE.docx). If this is acceptable we'll mark the HubSpot deal as "Legal review" and route the SOW + PO to your legal/procurement for signature. We expect this package to satisfy your budget board on 30 Jun.

If you prefer a different split of migration credit vs discount we can rework, but this is the most balanced package our finance will approve without a formal executive credit escalation. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call to finalize.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_BrightPath_REDLINE.docx
